levels.name: Executes
levels.detail: Does the work as designed by others: follows the established procedures, protocols or standards of the field, reliably.

levels.name: Maintains
levels.short: Owns and runs existing work well
levels.detail: Keeps an existing program, process or caseload running well and up to standard, trains others in it, and handles routine issues.

levels.name: Builds
levels.detail: Creates a program, process or system that didn't exist, or rebuilds one from the ground up.

levels.name: Improves
levels.short: Diagnoses with data and measurably improves
levels.detail: Finds root causes, evaluates what's working with evidence, and changes systems with measurable results.

levels.name: Leads
levels.short: Sets direction and is trusted when it matters most
levels.detail: Shapes approach across teams or sites, is brought in for crises and novel problems, and holds others accountable for results.

demonstrated.label: Demonstrated
demonstrated.detail: A specific example with actions and outcomes, ideally measured

described.label: Described
described.detail: Stated as a responsibility, without a concrete outcome

inferred.label: Inferred
inferred.detail: Implied by job titles, skills or education only

story_prompts.title: A problem you got to the bottom of
story_prompts.hint: Something that went wrong, or kept going wrong: how you found the real cause and what you changed so it didn’t happen again.

story_prompts.title: A risk you caught early
story_prompts.hint: Something you noticed before it became a problem, and what you did about it.

story_prompts.title: A crisis you handled
story_prompts.hint: An urgent situation where things were going wrong fast: your role, the decisions you made, and how it ended.

story_prompts.title: Something you built or fixed
story_prompts.hint: A process, program, tool or way of working you created or rebuilt, and how you knew it worked.

story_prompts.title: Numbers that changed a decision
story_prompts.hint: Results or data you tracked that led to a real change, with the before and after.

story_prompts.title: Getting others on board
story_prompts.hint: Getting a team, customer, partner or leadership to own a problem and follow through.
